result.topic_en: A heavily corrected prose draft summarising Riemann's results on plane air waves of finite amplitude: an initial disturbance splits into two waves, values of density travel at a density-dependent speed, compression waves steepen into compression shocks, and there are remarks on comparison with experiment, acoustics and meteorology.
